cor.heading: Revenues and Cost of revenues
cor.text: We have not generated revenue from the sale of EVs. No cost of revenues incurred during the period.

rd.heading: Research and Development
rd.text: We have incurred minimal research and development expenses for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026 and 2025. The research and development expenses were recorded in “general and administrative expenses” in the unaudited condensed consolidated statements of operations and comprehensive loss.

ga.heading: General and administrative expenses
ga.text: General and administrative expenses primarily consist of personnel salary and welfare expenses and professional and consulting expenses. Over the next several years, we anticipate an increase in our general and administrative expenses related to professional and consulting expenses associated with uplisting to NASDAQ and acquisition of other income-generating companies.

net.text: Net loss. As a result of the foregoing, we incurred a net loss of approximately $0.4 million and $0.5 million for the three months ended June 30, 2026 and 2025, respectively.

ocf.heading: Operating Activities
ocf.text:
Net cash used in operating activities for the six months ended June 30, 2026 was approximately $0.5 million, primarily attributable to net loss of approximately $0.9 million, adjusted for non-cash item of share of equity loss of approximately $0.1 million, and for changes in operating assets and liabilities, including an increase of approximately $0.2 million due to related parties and an increase of approximately $0.2 million in other payable and accrued expenses.

Net cash used in operating activities for the six months ended June 30, 2025 was approximately $1.0 million, primarily attributable to net loss of approximately $1.3 million, adjusted for an increase of approximately $0.1 million in due to related parties and an increase of approximately $0.1 million in other payable and accrued expenses.

net sales.heading: Revenues and Cost of revenues
net sales.text: We have not generated revenue from the sale of EVs. No cost of revenues incurred during the period.

intro.text: Prior to June 21, 2024, we were known as Feutune Light Acquisition Corporation, a Delaware corporation (“FLFV”), and Feutune Light Merger Sub, Inc., a Delaware corporation and wholly owned subsidiary of FLFV (“Merger Sub”). On October 26, 2023, we entered into a business combination agreement (as amended, the “Business Combination Agreement”) with Thunder Power Holdings Limited, a British Virgin Islands company (“Thunder Power”), pursuant to which on June 21, 2024, Thunder Power merged with and into Merger Sub, with Merger Sub surviving the merger as a wholly owned subsidiary of FLFV (the “Merger” and, together with the other transactions contemplated by the Business Combination Agreement and any other agreement executed and delivered in connection therewith, the “Business Combination”).

lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Short-term investments
lines.why: Securities held for the cash they will return: financial.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Other assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total assets minus the lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total liabilities minus the lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.
